entry_state: Chapter 14 separates engineering, accounting, forecasting and human acceptance. Corpus acquisition is not independent validation, and provisional workload limits preserve partial coverage. Appendix A now supplies the portable operation signatures needed to implement the preceding semantics.
exit_state: The portable reference binds profile-specific records and typed dependencies while preserving partial financial answers. Its operations distinguish preparation, admission, selection, assessment, authorization, proposal and atomic commit. Reporting, explanation, recovery and store exchange follow.
findings: Corporate and joined-company packages specify exact documentary exchanges without establishing deployed durability.
Real-source packages preserve reported observations, unknowns and conditional amounts as distinct records.
The operation summaries preserve the separation of pure computation, candidate construction and transactions. No new confirmed manuscript defect.
